# Claude handoff kit

Everything a **new Claude account** needs to pick up **AmberX AXF** (MossesX/AmberX-AXF) and keep building it to spec.
Start at [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md); the prompt that sends a new account here is [PROMPT.md](PROMPT.md).

The Dev Console's **Tools → Claude handoff** keeps this folder current (it reminds every 6 hours). Don't edit these
files by hand: change the sources (CLAUDE.md, `_claude/`, the claude.ai list in the console) and refresh the kit.
